newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher as market remains rangebound.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher as market remains rangebound.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher as the market remained rangebound and without direction, traders said.
Floor sources said small lot commercial buying remained under the market but producer sell orders continued to limit advances along with a weak tone in the Asian cash market.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 350 contracts, above the 200 contracts traded Wednesday.
Rice closed seven to nine cents per cwt higher, with January up seven at $10.53 per cwt.
